prior_error: AssertionError: Expected values to be strictly equal: 2 !== 0
root_cause: The first rehearsal created its scratch root under /tmp/t078-a13-rehearsal-*. HookTrace.start accepts only a state parent under /private/tmp/t078-2-* and therefore the real signal entry rejected the UserPromptSubmit before daemon handling with exit code 2 (invalid_hook_trace_binding).
fix: Use /private/tmp/t078-2-a13-rehearsal-* and bind roles/ideation/hooks to that root; do not relax the production HookTrace boundary.
followup_fixture_fixes: controller launch records now carry env.A2A_REQUEST_DIR
processInfo is keyed by thread so ideation and executor native identities are not crossed
inbox delivery readback selects the newest append-only receipt
state queries filter JSON data.kind because inbox_records has no kind column
